title: The Sufficient supply of water
subtitle: 循环利用 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 循环利用（人与自然·环境保护·循环利用与节约）
meta: 主题语境：循环利用（人与自然·环境保护·循环利用与节约）　|　核心词汇：sufficient　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sufficient 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 the driver wrote of ① a sufficient supply of water in the timetable, and everybody in the station said at once that it was ② so sufficient that nobody in the station would go near it. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the driver, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the sufficient ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the sufficient supply of water that anybody there had ever seen, or so the timetable for February 1976 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too sufficient to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the passenger who had come to help; the sufficient ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a sufficient reason for the delay, and said that no passenger in his right mind would call it ⑥ as sufficient as the reason for the delay they had once had in the old station. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was sufficient or not, and he said so.

By 1989 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the timetable. What the line asked for was ⑦ something sufficient, and nothing besides. The passenger from the next station called the whole plan ⑧ quite sufficient; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the timetable kept the names of the sufficient ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1992, in public, she wrote of another sufficient supply of water in the same timetable, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ no less sufficient than anybody had expected. ⑩ The sufficient reason for the delay that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1994, was the one she could never quite name; the sufficient ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 充足（前置定语 a sufficient supply of water：1982 年司机在时刻表里记下的那件充足的供水）
B. adj. 充足／充分（两处加强说法：so sufficient that … 与 no less sufficient than …）
C. adj. 充足／充分（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 充足（表语 too sufficient to do：母亲觉得它太充足，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 充分（前置定语 a sufficient reason for the delay：叔叔把整件事称作一桩充分的理由）
F. adj. 充分（同级比较 as sufficient as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩拖延的充分理由相比）
G. adj. 充分（后置定语 something sufficient：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 充分（受程度副词修饰 quite sufficient：那位乘客的评价）

items.q: the sufficient supply of water that
a sufficient reason for the delay
The sufficient reason for the delay that

answers.why: sufficient 意为“充足”，1982 年司机在时刻表里记下的是“一件充足的供水”，此处作前置定语 a sufficient supply of water。
sufficient 意为“充足”，此处用 so sufficient that 结构，说它充足到车站里没人敢靠近。
sufficient 意为“充足”，时刻表上 二月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的充足充足的供水，等于最高级的说法。
sufficient 意为“充足”，母亲认为这件东西“太充足了，谁也用不上”，too sufficient to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
sufficient 意为“充分”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩充分的理由”，此处作前置定语 a sufficient reason for the delay。
sufficient 意为“充分”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩拖延的充分理由一样充分”，同级比较用 as sufficient as。
sufficient 意为“充分”，时刻表上那半行字要的是“充分的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something sufficient。
sufficient 意为“充分”，邻车站来的那位乘客认为这套计划“相当充分”，quite 修饰原级 sufficient。
sufficient 意为“充分”，no less sufficient than 表示“其充分不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之充分不亚于任何人的预料。
sufficient 意为“充分”，母亲 1994 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的充分理由”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1982 年，司机在时刻表里记下了一件充足的供水。（a sufficient supply of water）
它充足到车站里没有一个人敢靠近。（so sufficient that …）
母亲觉得它太充足，谁也用不上。（too sufficient to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩充分的理由。（a sufficient reason for the delay）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩拖延的充分理由一样充分。（as sufficient as …）
到了 1989 年，时刻表上只剩半行字：要的是一件充分的东西。（something sufficient）
answers: In 1982 the driver wrote of a sufficient supply of water in the timetable.
It was so sufficient that nobody in the station would go near it.
My mother thought it too sufficient to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a sufficient reason for the delay.
He said nobody would call it as sufficient as the reason for the delay they had once had.
By 1989 the timetable asked for nothing but something sufficient.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 sufficient 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1982 the driver wrote of a sufficient supply of water in the timetable, and nobody forgot it.
It was the sufficient supply of water that anybody there had ever seen, or so the timetable says.
My mother thought it too sufficient to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a sufficient reason for the delay, and nobody argued with him.
The passenger from the next station called the plan quite sufficient, and everybody laughed.
The sufficient ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
